name: coding-agent
description: Takes a Technical Design Document (PDF) and pushes one new branch with the implementing commit to every affected service's repo — no Pull Request, so CI (Jenkins) can be checked first.

triggers.name: uploaded_files
triggers.description: The Technical Design Document to implement, as a PDF.

triggers.name: branch_name
triggers.description: Name of the NEW branch to push in every repo the TDD changes, e.g. sm/KS-17392-2. It must not exist yet. Leave empty for a generated fix/... name.
